artifacts.title: Ordination vows require compliance with Assembly rules of order

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that delegates are bound by ordination vows to follow PCA constitutional rules, and that changing unscriptural standards requires proper amendment procedures, not suspension.

artifacts.title: Confessional subscription and amendment of exception-stating requirements

matches.evidence: An overture from Grace Presbytery amending BCO Preface II, chapter 16, and BCO 21-4 regarding doctrinal subscription was found in conflict with the second ordination vow.
